column1: # Served-member refusals the batch 12 harness exposes on cases that predate the stop pins (owner: trunk until the family lane takes each; due 2026-11-26 UTC).
# Columns: parity file, case name, member that refused, owner, due date, what Rust declines.

column2: listExactIdentityCandidates finds a page by its phone digits in every value shape, and emailsOnly drops the phone and title arms
column6: Rust declines listExactIdentityCandidates (a phone probe), capability pages

column2: whois by a phone number matches the canonical number, honours the country code setting and hides private pages from a remote caller
column6: Rust declines listExactIdentityCandidates (a phone probe), capability pages

column2: readMemberPageWithdrawal finds the withdrawal a save onto a member page meets: its own subject first, another subject only for a row the member reads
column6: Rust declines readMemberPageWithdrawal (the owner read of a member page (lineage access is not modelled)), capability facts

column2: the foreign keys read from the catalog; a store that keeps no list of them refuses by name
column6: Rust declines listCatalogForeignKeys (the store checks each family's references in code and keeps no list of them), capability raw_sql

column2: with a non-English full-text language the Rust engine refuses the saved-facts match instead of answering none
column6: Rust declines matchSavedFacts (FTS language german), capability facts

column2: entityFeatureCoverage: a 100 percent sample is the whole population (the Rust store declines a sample)
column6: Rust declines entityFeatureCoverage (a TABLESAMPLE percent (the store reads every page)), capability links

column2: the count asked inside a remote caller record answers the same, or the Rust arm refuses it
column6: Rust declines countOpenPages (an open-page floor rendered in a caller record), capability access_control

column2: readLinkTargetPages judges an empty writer policy like the SQL engines
column6: Rust declines readLinkTargetPages (a writer whose folder rules, owner record, labelled-only grant or identities widen the member-access policy), capability persistence_journal

column2: supersedingPageSlugs: a read that cannot run rejects instead of answering an empty map; an edge written after an empty answer is seen at once
column6: Rust declines supersedingPageSlugs (a page id that is not an integer), capability links

column2: putPage stores an NFD slug in NFC, and an NFD wikilink names that page
column6: Rust declines putPage (a slug in Unicode NFC), capability pages
